design: Three unseen dates x two 12/48h horizons x four arms. One trial per arm, two process lanes (12 h and 48 h), rotated order. All on same shared host; descriptive timings only. 45s from input parsing through validation, last 0.8s reserved for check; supervisor stops after 45.25s. No safe common incumbent. Solver/prep/full-stage clocks cumulative. No cross-arm reference solution access. Outer bound from full solver, optimal full relaxation bound discounted by 1e-7 relative for numerical scope. Inner bounds only scoped to restriction. Practical threshold: 0.1% lower feasible cost versus both full and LP-start at identical deadline; target 0.5% full-model gap.
selected: Minimum validated incumbent at 45s on W03 12h RTS for two full-solver efforts. 30% candidate time chosen a priori for both heuristics and exercised on development. Ten-percent high-confidence LP commitment thresholds. Temporary restrictions removed by reloading exact original HighsModel and checking row and integral counts.
falsifier: No advantage over LP-start and full at matched quality/availability. Report each individual date, row and bound failures.
